say.en: A brand-new laptop with no software is just an expensive paperweight. What kinds of software bring it to life? In this lesson: Classify software as system software, programming tools and application software.
Compare compiler, interpreter and assembler.
Distinguish proprietary, freeware and free and open-source software.

body.en: System *software* runs and manages the hardware: the operating system, system utilities (disk cleanup, antivirus, backup) and device drivers, which let the OS talk to a particular device. Programming tools help write programs: language translators and program development tools such as IDEs. Application software does a user's task. General-purpose applications (word processors, spreadsheets, browsers) serve many users; customised applications are built for one organisation, such as a college's fee management system.

narration.en: An application never talks to the hardware directly. Its request passes down through the operating system and a device driver to the hardware, and the result comes back up. Utility software such as an antivirus can sit in between. Play it for each application. Which layer changes, and which stay the same? Why does one operating system serve every application?

title.en: On the board: Kinds of software and language translators

say.en: Software is the set of programs. It splits into three families.
System software runs the hardware: the operating system, utilities and device drivers.
Programming tools help us write programs: translators, debuggers and IDEs.
Application software does a user’s task: general purpose like a word processor, or customised like a school fee system. It can be free and open source or proprietary.
The computer runs only machine code. Translators convert our programs into it.
An assembler is a third translator: it converts assembly language into machine code.

body.en: Computers understand only machine *language* (0s and 1s). An assembler translates assembly language into machine code. A compiler translates a whole high-level program at once and lists all errors together. An interpreter translates and runs one statement at a time and stops at the first error; Python uses an interpreter. Software may be proprietary (sold with a licence, source code closed), freeware (free to use, source not shared) or free and open-source software (FOSS), whose source code anyone can study, change and share, such as Linux, Python and LibreOffice.

points.en: Interpreter: line by line, stops at first error
FOSS: source code open to study, modify and share

problem.en: Classify: (a) Python interpreter (b) printer driver (c) a hospital's patient billing system built for it (d) a spreadsheet program.

steps.en: A translator that converts Python code is a programming tool, so (a) is a programming tool.
A driver lets the OS control a device, so (b) is system software.
A program built for one organisation's needs is customised application software: (c).
A spreadsheet serves many users, so (d) is general-purpose application software.

answer.en: (a) programming tool, (b) system software, (c) customised application, (d) general-purpose application

say.en: Let us work through this together. Classify: a Python interpreter b printer driver c a hospital's patient billing system built for it d a spreadsheet program.
A translator that converts Python code is a programming tool, so a is a programming tool.
A driver lets the OS control a device, so b is system software.
A program built for one organisation's needs is customised application software: c.
A spreadsheet serves many users, so d is general-purpose application software.
So the answer is a programming tool, b system software, c customised application, d general-purpose application.

body.en: A compiler is like translating a whole book before anyone reads it. An interpreter is like a live translator at a speech: sentence by sentence, and it stops when it hits a sentence it cannot understand.

say.kn: ಮುಖ್ಯ ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ನೆನಪಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋಣ. ತಂತ್ರಾಂಶ, ಸಿಸ್ಟಮ್, ಪ್ರೋಗ್ರಾಮಿಂಗ್ ಉಪಕರಣ ಅಥವಾ ಅನ್ವಯಿಕ.

say.en: A compiler translates all at once; an interpreter goes line by line.
say.kn: ಕಂಪೈಲರ್ ಒಮ್ಮೆಗೇ; ಇಂಟರ್‌ಪ್ರಿಟರ್ ಸಾಲು ಸಾಲಾಗಿ ಅನುವಾದಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: An assembler translates assembly language to machine code.
say.kn: ಅಸೆಂಬ್ಲರ್ ಅಸೆಂಬ್ಲಿ ಭಾಷೆಯನ್ನು ಯಂತ್ರ ಭಾಷೆಗೆ ಅನುವಾದಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: FOSS shares its source code; proprietary software does not.
say.kn: FOSS ಮೂಲ ಕೋಡ್ ಹಂಚುತ್ತದೆ; ಸ್ವಾಮ್ಯದ ತಂತ್ರಾಂಶ ಹಂಚುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

say.en: Next: Operating system.
